dataset: National Heritage List for England NHLE v02 VIEW — Listed Building polygons (layer 3)
data_date: 2022-06-07 (Bridge Inn most recent NHLE amendment); layer accessed 2026-10-03
evidence_slice: Historic England's official National Heritage List for England ArcGIS FeatureServer exposes layer 3 'Listed Building polygons' as esriGeometryPolygon with ListEntry, Name, Grade, ListDate, AmendDate, CaptureScale, hyperlink, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing fields. The official NHLE record for ListEntry 1306502 is 'Bridge Inn', Bridge Hill, Topsham, Exeter, Devon, EX3 0QQ, Grade II, first listed 11 November 1952 and most recently amended 7 June 2022; the name explicitly evidences inn building type/use. The distinct exact record query where ListEntry=1306502 with returnGeometry=true could not be retrieved through the web channel, and direct DNS resolution of services-eu1.arcgis.com failed before a feature payload was received. No polygon coordinates were inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon and supports GeoJSON, but the exact ListEntry 1306502 response was not retrievable; no polygon coordinates were read.
field_evidence.type_use: Official NHLE List Entry 1306502 is named Bridge Inn, directly evidencing Inn building type/use.
field_evidence.heritage: Official NHLE record identifies Grade II, first listed 1952-11-11, most recently amended 2022-06-07, Topsham, Exeter.
